r: Reset your Podman machine environment. This command stops any running machines and then removes them. Configuration and data files are then removed. Data files would include machine disk images and any previously pulled cache images. When this command is run, all of your Podman machines will have been deleted.

--force, -f

Reset without confirmation.

--help

Print usage statement.

$ podman machine reset
Warning: this command will delete all existing podman machines
and all of the configuration and data directories for Podman machines
The following machine(s) will be deleted:
dev
podman-machine-default
Are you sure you want to continue? [y/N] y
$
